scope.next_row_language: complete L*/(X|H)+/R* or L*/(X|H|S)+/R*, center width 1..5
scope.cap_pairing: all ordered top-depth/bottom-depth pairs; top and bottom D4 transforms may be selected independently

pairing_interpretation: Pairs are filtered by exact charge attainability and separately by whether both caps admit a declared next row. All leave an unsearched gap, so no merge profile or direct compatibility is claimed.
